title: The Reborn
summary: An anti-fossil-fuel extremist faction that drives Compromised's Gulf Coast refinery conflict.

claims.text: Compromised identifies the Reborn as the force attacking southern food convoys and advancing on Gulf Coast refinery communities.
The faction's broadcasts frame continuing fossil-fuel production as an offense that must be stopped, making the Groves refinery a primary target.
The novel reveals that the Reborn's leadership accepted military material from rogue agents, who used the faction as part of a wider Gulf Coast manipulation.

paragraphs.text: The Reborn target the transport and refinery infrastructure that survivor communities rely on, presenting their campaign as a break with fossil-fuel dependence.
Compromised presents the faction as a manipulated actor rather than an isolated Gulf Coast force: rogue agents supply its leadership while steering the regional confrontation toward their own goals.

verification.notes: A licensed-novel faction record. It does not generalize the Reborn beyond the Gulf Coast story in Compromised.
